lineage: This evolved set was changed during development after v1.0.0. It is retained for regression inspection and must not be called independent held-out evaluation.

questions.question: How long does a passwordless sign-in link remain valid?
questions.expected_answer: A sign-in link expires after fifteen minutes.

questions.question: Who must review privileged accounts each quarter?
questions.expected_answer: An Administrator must review active Operator and Administrator accounts.

questions.question: What encoding is required for a record import CSV?
questions.expected_answer: Use a CSV file encoded as UTF-8 with a header row.

questions.question: Where do cases go if no routing rule matches?
questions.expected_answer: The case enters the General Review queue.

questions.question: What should happen first for exposed credentials?
questions.expected_answer: Revoke the affected token or session first.

questions.question: How long are approved reports retained?
questions.expected_answer: Approved reports are retained for 90 days after generation.

questions.question: Can exports include raw attachments?
questions.expected_answer: Raw attachments are never included in a standard export.

questions.question: What vacation policy is available for contractors?
What is the session idle timeout for an operator?
questions.expected_answer: An operator session expires after eight hours of inactivity.

questions.question: Which role can create redacted exports?
questions.expected_answer: The Operator role can create redacted exports.

questions.question: What are the required import columns?
questions.expected_answer: The required columns are case_id, customer_region, opened_at, and summary.

questions.question: Do routing edits move existing cases automatically?
questions.expected_answer: Existing cases keep their current owner until reassigned.

questions.question: How frequently must customers receive an outage update?
questions.expected_answer: Publish a customer-facing update every sixty minutes while a confirmed outage remains active.

questions.question: What does a legal hold prevent?
questions.expected_answer: A legal hold prevents scheduled deletion until the hold is removed.

questions.question: When does an export link expire?
questions.expected_answer: An export link expires after twenty-four hours.

questions.question: How many downstream retries does ingestion use?
questions.expected_answer: The ingestion worker retries a transient downstream failure up to three times.

questions.question: How many resolved cases are sampled per Operator each month?
questions.expected_answer: Supervisors sample ten resolved cases per Operator each month.

questions.question: For how long does the notification service deduplicate an event identifier?
questions.expected_answer: The notification service deduplicates notifications by event identifier for thirty days.
